rita: Follow-up from yesterday's canary incident. Need a short owner+due list for rollout safety work: auto-rollback, default blast-radius, and recurrence alerts.
maria: I'll own policy doc + tests — due 2026-04-08.
lex: I'll spec/runtime hooks for rollback_key — due 2026-04-15. Runtime should return a rollback_key that expires after 48h.
kevin: CI guard and canary-sim job — due 2026-04-06. I'll add smoke assertions.
elaine: telemetry + recurrence detector prototype — due 2026-04-18. Need infra access to historical canary events.
rita: proposed defaults: max_blast_radius=10% service-wide; per-route >10% needs explicit approver + safety justification.
maria: policy triggers draft: immediate rollback if error_rate >=3% for 5m; reduce traffic 50% if p95 >= 2x baseline for 2 windows; route to stable if new_variant_share >=60% within 5m.
lex: API note: rollout POST accepts safety_profile_id; response includes rollback_key. I'll open PR.
kevin: CI snippet added to tracker. will iterate on infra perms. :wrench:
ops-bot: Reminder set: tabletop drill 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC assigned to rita.
rita: I'll create the GH tracker and post links here. Please add PRs to the issue. If blockers, flag here and I'll escalate.
